subject: Re: Model regression after update  next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chang <alex.chang@retailco.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: quick recap + next steps on model fit and evals

Hi Alex 

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery: RetailCo is seeing good throughput on generation use cases but you've noticed a drop in qualitative accuracy for product categorization after last weekend's model version update. Key items we captured:

- Primary workload: short product descriptions (avg 45 tokens) -> categorical label output across 12 categories
- Signal: previously ~94% accuracy, post-update sample shows ~86% on your golden set
- Requirements: determinism for downstream inventory mapping, latency budget ~120ms p50, and strong regression guardrails

Next steps I promised on the call:
1) Share the eval diffs you mentioned and the prompt set we used (attached).
2) Recommend model variants and a rollback/pinning plan we can implement quickly.
3) Propose a short validation run (2–3k examples) and a canary pin for one route.

I've attached the prompt-set-retailco.csv and a small extract of the diffs you sent (retailco-eval-diff-20270601.csv). Mateo is looped in to recommend the concrete model pin and technical steps.

Would you be available for a 30-min follow-up tomorrow to review the diff and agree the rollback window?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: prompt-set-retailco.csv (CSV, 120KB), retailco-eval-diff-20270601.csv (CSV, 2.1MB)

From: Alex Chang <alex.chang@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Ho <evelyn.ho@retailco.com>, Procurement <procurement@retailco.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick recap + next steps on model fit and evals

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the recap and for attaching the csvs. A few clarifying points from our side:

- The regression appears correlated with the model family change (redwood-open-rtx v1.3.x). We didn't expect behavior change on label mapping.
- We reproduced the drop locally on our golden set; attached are a couple of example failures (included in retailco-eval-diff).
- Procurement is looped for any change control / freeze windows  we’ll need a short outage/maintenance slot if a rollback requires it.

Please ask mateo for the rollback/pin plan. Ideally we pin to the last known-good version and run a quick validation before wider rollout. Also please include links to any benchmark runs that compare v1.2.x -> v1.3.x for small-sequence classification.

Appreciate the quick turnaround  available for a 30-min window tomorrow at 11:00 AM PT.
—Alex
Alex Chang
Director, Product Data Science
RetailCo

Attachments: examples extracted to retailco-eval-diff-20270601.csv

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chang <alex.chang@retailco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick recap + next steps on model fit and evals

Hi Alex 

Thanks for sharing the diffs. I pulled a quick comparison across your prompt set against our benchmark-suite-v2 (attached) and saw the following:

- v1.3.0 -> v1.3.2: small but consistent shift in tokenization for short sequences affecting label anchors (precision drop ~6–8% on your gold set).
- Qualitative: more aggressive canonicalization of partial SKU tokens introduced slight label drift for mixed alpha-numeric product codes.

Recommendations (fast path):
1) Roll back the inference route to redwood-open-rtx@v1.2.9 (the last-known-good). This is reversible and should restore previous behavior for your route.
2) Pin the route to v1.2.9 for 72 hours while we run a 3k validation run against your prompt set. If green, we can staged-test v1.3.x variants with tighter prompt anchoring.
3) We'll also run a targeted diff that isolates tokenization changes and propose minor prompt sanitization patterns (examples in the attached prompt-set-retailco.csv).

If you want a technical playbook, see rollback-instructions.txt (attached)  includes the API call and the exact route config diff. Summary below:

- API call to pin: POST /v1/routes/{route_id}/pin with payload {"model": "redwood-open-rtx", "version": "v1.2.9"} (we'll run this with you)
- Canary: route param canary_percent=10 for initial 2-hour window before full pin

I can lead the rollback with you on the call tomorrow at 11:00 AM PT. Vivek is cc'd for escalation/authorization if needed.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com

Attachments: benchmark-suite-v2.pdf, rollback-instructions.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chang <alex.chang@retailco.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@retailco.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick recap + next steps on model fit and evals

Alex 

Confirmed for 11:00 AM PT tomorrow. Plan of record for the call:

1) Quick walkthrough of the eval diffs (10 min)  Marissa/Mateo
2) Execute a 10% canary pin to v1.2.9 and run a 500-sample smoke test live (15 min)  Mateo
3) If smoke is green, expand to 100% and schedule 3k validation (post-call)  Alex/Procurement to confirm freeze window
4) If green, we'll schedule staged re-introduction of v1.3.x with prompt anchoring and additional benchmarks

Please confirm procurement availability for a 60-minute change window tonight/tomorrow if the rollback needs the full route repointing (rare but good to have on hand).

Thanks  looking forward to resolving quickly.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments referenced: prompt-set-retailco.csv, retailco-eval-diff-20270601.csv

From: Alex Chang <alex.chang@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick recap + next steps on model fit and evals

All 

Thanks everyone for the call earlier and for the clear rollback playbook. Procurement confirmed a 60-minute maintenance slot for tomorrow at 02:00 AM PT (low traffic). We want Redwood to proceed with the canary at that time:

- Start: 2027-06-03 02:00 AM PT
- Canary: 10% -> smoke test (500 samples)
- Contingency: immediate rollback to v1.3.2 if failures exceed 3% on the golden set

Please open a support ticket so we have a tracked incident and timeline for auditing. Also, can you pin the route config after the rollback and provide the config diff for our change log?

Appreciate the partnership  Alex

Cc: Procurement
